desc: Formalize the minimum-cost formula (sum of running prefix maxima minus sum) and prove setting each final value to the prefix maximum is optimal.
Establish the sliding-window monotonicity: cost nondecreasing in R and nonincreasing in L.
Two-pointer invariant and accumulation: for each right, count valid lefts as right-left+1.
Implement Approach 1: binary lifting over next strictly greater chains with partial final block and O(log n) cost queries.
Run Examples 1 and 2 (17, 12) and brute-force compare on random small cases; worker reported solved.
Performance/memory check at n=1e5 with array('q') tables (~27 MB, O(n log n)).
